I wrote the page to `./solution.tsx`. I couldn't run it, so it's untested.

It's built on the kit's `Dialog`, which follows the kit's own delete-confirmation example. That component handles the focus trap, Escape and closing on a click outside. It also returns focus to the trigger when the dialog closes.

- **Trigger:** a secondary "Delete project" button opens the dialog.
- **Dialog:** the title is "Delete this project?" and the description is "Its files and history are removed. This cannot be undone."
- **Actions:** "Keep project" (secondary) closes the dialog. The primary "Delete" button closes it and sets the status text.
- **Status text:** "Project deleted." sits beside the trigger in a `role="status"` span, so screen readers announce it. It is empty until Delete is pressed.
